Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: Initiates a FIX session with the NASDAQ OMX PSX INET order entry gateway. Encryption not supported. First message of the session; no further messages until PSX verifies the SenderCompID.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval in seconds.

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: Ignored.

Field.Name: RawDataLength
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: RawData
Field.Description: Not supported.

Message.Name: NewOrderSingle
Message.Description: Submits a new order to NASDAQ OMX PSX for execution. New Order messages received with a duplicate ClOrdID are ignored regardless of PossResend.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by institution. Up to 64 characters.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: Always 1 (Automated execution order, private, no Broker intervention).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker symbol in native INET symbology (root and suffix included).

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order.

Field.Name: GroupId
Field.Description: Numeric XXXXX, max 32767.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Required.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type. Pegged requires ExecInst = P or R.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Required for Limit orders.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Firm identification for third-party transactions. Must be a valid NASD-assigned MPID of a registered broker dealer.

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: Destination to route the order. Currently INET, PMOP, PSTG, PSCN, PTFY, PCRT, TFYX, XCST, XDRK, PSKN, PSKP, DOTA, DOTD, DOTI, DOTM, SCAR, and Directed Order Destination Codes. Defaults to INET.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Up to 32 characters.

Field.Name: SettlmntTyp
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: FutSettDate
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Space-delimited instructions. Supported peg types M, N, P, R; f for ISO; B Trade Now; b Trade Now opt-out.

Field.Name: DisplayInst
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX PSX display options.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum quantity. Must be a round lot.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Displayed portion of the order. Must be a round lot.

Field.Name: LocateReqd
Field.Description: Required for short sale orders. Must be N; the order entry firm is always responsible for locating the stock.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Time-in-force. Absence interpreted as Market Hours (DAY).

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: Order capacity. All values supported. Default A (Agent).

Field.Name: PegDifference
Field.Description: Offset amount for the pegged value. FIX standard conservative approach.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text. Restricted to 128 bytes or the session disconnects.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Time the order should be cancelled. Good Till Time orders (59=6) with ExpireTime later than the current trading day are rejected.

Field.Name: MarketabilityInstructions
Field.Description: Marketability instruction. 0 = None.

Field.Name: DisplayRange
Field.Description: Amount used to determine the random reserve range around MaxFloor.

Field.Name: DisplayExecInst
Field.Description: Pegs the display price of the order. Market Peg P, Primary Peg R, Mid Peg M.

Field.Name: DisplayPrice
Field.Description: Price to display on the NASDAQ OMX PSX book.

Field.Name: DisplayPegDifference
Field.Description: Offset for a pegged display price as specified in DisplayExecInst (9391).

Field.Name: CrossTradeFlag
Field.Description: Specifies the cross in which this order goes live.

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: Set to NX to send a Direct+ order on DOT strategies.

Field.Name: LocateBroker
Field.Description: Broker code from which the locate has been acquired for short sale orders.

Message.Name: OrderCancelRequest
Message.Description: Requests cancellation of all remaining quantity of an existing order. Accepted only if the order can be pulled back without executing. Use Order Cancel/Replace to partially cancel (reduce) an order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the previous order in the chain (not the initial order of the day).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of cancel request. Up to 64 characters.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker symbol in native INET symbology.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Required. CashOrderQty not supported.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of most recent order as assigned by broker.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Firm identification for third-party transactions. Valid NASD-assigned MPID.

Message.Name: OrderCancelReplaceRequest
Message.Description: Order Modification Request. Only Price and shares (OrderQty) may change. All other fields should be retransmitted as sent in the original order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the previous order in the chain (not the initial order of the day).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the replacement order. Up to 64 characters.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: Always 1 (Automated execution order, private, no Broker intervention).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker symbol in native INET symbology.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Must match original side.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Required. CashOrderQty not supported.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type. Pegged requires ExecInst = P or R.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Required for Limit orders.

Field.Name: LocateReqd
Field.Description: Required for short sale orders.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of most recent order as assigned by broker.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Firm identification for third-party transactions. Valid NASD-assigned MPID.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Space-delimited. M, N, P, R peg types; f for ISO.

Field.Name: DisplayInst
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX PSX display options.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Time-in-force of the original order carries through to all replacements.

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: Capacity of the original order carries through to all replacements.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Not supported. Account of the original order carries through to all replacements.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Not supported. MinQty of the original order carries through to all replacements.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Not supported. MaxFloor of the original order carries through to all replacements.

Message.Name: OrderPurgeRequest
Message.Description: Initiates cancellation of one or more booked orders matching the criteria, or disables/enables new order submission for an MPID. If no optional criteria are specified, all orders for the account are cancelled.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Up to 32 characters.

Field.Name: PurgeRequestType
Field.Description: 1 Cancel orders, 2 Disable MPID, 3 Enable MPID.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Valid NASD-assigned MPID.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker symbol in native INET symbology.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order.

Field.Name: GroupId
Field.Description: Numeric XXXXX, max 32767.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by institution. Up to 64 characters.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Assigned by NASDAQ OMX PSX. Unique per chain of orders.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Execution identifier as assigned by broker. Zero for status messages. Based on the OUCH match number for fills.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: Transaction type. Trade breaks use 1 (Cancel). Corrections not supported.

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: Destination. Defaults to INET.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Type of execution report. Same possible values as OrdStatus, plus D Restated.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Current state of the chain of orders.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker symbol in native INET symbology.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order.

Field.Name: GroupId
Field.Description: Numeric XXXXX, max 32767.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Order quantity.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Shares open for further execution. Zero when the order is no longer active, otherwise OrderQty minus CumQty.

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Currently executed shares for the chain of orders.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Calculated average price of all fills on this order.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Required for Cancel and Correct ExecTransType messages.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: As specified in the new order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: As specified in the new order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: As specified in the new order.

Field.Name: PegDifference
Field.Description: As specified in the new order.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Returned if specified on the original order.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Space-delimited. M, N, P, R peg types; f for ISO.

Field.Name: DisplayInst
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX PSX display options.

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Used when reporting other than current day trades.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Absence indicates Market Hours order.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type. 2 Limit, P Pegged (requires ExecInst of P or R).

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of execution / order creation (GMT). Appears on all messages.

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: All values supported. Default A (Agent).

Field.Name: LiquidityFlag
Field.Description: Returned within execution reports containing a partial or full fill.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: As specified in the new order.

Field.Name: NoContraBroker
Field.Description: Number of ContraBroker (375) entries. Always 1.

Field.Name: ExtendedReasonCode
Field.Description: Identifies the order reject reason. See Appendix A Extended Order Reject Codes.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity bought/sold on this last fill. Always 0 for restatement.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this last fill.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Identifies the contra broker / routing destination.

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Number of ContraBrokers repeating group instances. This field will be present in the message if the OrdStatus = 1 or 2.

Field.Name: LastLiquidityInd
Field.Description: Indicator to identify whether this fill was a result of a liquidity provider providing or liquidity taker taking the liquidity. Applicable only for OrdStatus of Partial or Filled.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity bought/sold on this last fill. Always 0 for restatement.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this last fill.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Identifies the contra broker / routing destination.

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Number of ContraBrokers repeating group instances. This field will be present in the message if the OrdStatus = 1 or 2.

Field.Name: LastLiquidityInd
Field.Description: Indicator to identify whether this fill was a result of a liquidity provider providing or liquidity taker taking the liquidity. Applicable only for OrdStatus of Partial or Filled.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the previous order on cancel/replace.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the previous order on cancel/replace.

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for order rejection. Valid values: 0 = Broker option 1 = Unknown symbol 2 = Exchange closed 3 = Order exceeds limit 4 = Too late to enter 5 = Unknown Order 6 = Duplicate Order (e.g. dupe ClOrdID) 7 = Duplicate of a verbally communicated order 8 = Stale Order

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text.

Field.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Field.Description: For restatements always 5 (Partial decline of OrderQty).

Message.Name: OrderCancelReject
Message.Description: Issued upon receipt of a Cancel Request or Cancel/Replace Request that cannot be honored.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: "Unknown" for unknown orders; otherwise the OrderID of the last order in the chain.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique order ID assigned by broker to the cancel request or replacement order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID that could not be cancelled/replaced (previous order in the chain).

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: OrdStatus value after this cancel reject is applied.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: For known orders, the ClientID specified in the original order.

Field.Name: CxlRejReason
Field.Description: Reason for cancel rejection.

Field.Name: CxlRejResponseTo
Field.Description: Indicates what was rejected. 1 cancel, 2 cancelReplace, 3 quote.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text. See Rejected Order Reasons.

Message.Name: OrderPurgeResponse
Message.Description: Issued upon receipt of an Order Purge Request or Disable/Enable Order Entry Request to indicate the action taken.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Up to 32 characters.

Field.Name: PurgeRequestType
Field.Description: 1 Cancel orders, 2 Disable MPID, 3 Enable MPID.

Field.Name: PurgeRequestResponse
Field.Description: Indicates the action taken by the counterparty order handling system as a result of the request.

Field.Name: RejectReason
Field.Description: Reject text describing why the request was rejected. Required when response = 0.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Valid NASD-assigned MPID.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker symbol in native INET symbology.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order.

Field.Name: GroupId
Field.Description: Numeric XXXXX, max 32767.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by institution. Up to 64 characters.

Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.0, FIX.4.1, or FIX.4.2. Always the first field.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Always the second field.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Always the third field.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: As assigned by NASDAQ OMX PSX. 4 to 6 characters. Returned as NQPX on outbound messages.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Always NQPX.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Sending time.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: 32 characters or less.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Ignored.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Always required for retransmitted messages.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Required when the message may be a duplicate of another sent under a different sequence number.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for resends. Same value as SendingTime if data is unavailable.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Standard FIX checksum.
